Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

helvetia 0.1.1

Source metadata (second review)

  • popGemeinde(): an unreadable spatial reference gives gem_stand_d = NA with a warning, as documented (it used to fail in the key check). Such results and their metadata are not cached.
  • popGemeinde() never labels new data with an older, unverified stand: metadata and spatial reference are cached as one unit, and if only a cached copy of the metadata is available, only year blocks cached with that stand are returned.
  • Cached cube metadata carry a format version; entries of 0.1.0 (without spatial reference) are ignored instead of failing.
  • Whole-number arguments reject Inf and values outside the integer range.

Hardening after the first review

  • popGemeinde() returns gem_stand_d, the municipality stand of the cube (“Raumbezug”), read from the BFS table page; the counts refer to 31 December of jahr_n, the municipalities to gem_stand_d. Years and ids must be whole numbers.
  • sourceInfo() keeps the original download time per cached block and the PXWeb POST selections (query).
  • combineRegions() stops if a unit is assigned to different groups; identical duplicates are dropped.
  • cacheClear()/cacheList() accept only the known source names.
  • arealGemeinde(): duplicated raw observations are an error; incomplete class sums are reported as not checkable (attr(, "sumCheck")); the cache key includes the region codelist (municipality stand).
  • ThemaKart: a refresh replaces the cached set only after a verified download; layers without id column or with conflicting duplicate ids are an error, multipart rows are unioned.
  • locate() keeps points with missing coordinates, reports n_treffer_n and has multiple = c("first", "na", "error").
  • addGewaesser() follows the CRS of the last map drawn (or crs); stampBfs() defaults to "bottomright".
  • HTTP requests use explicit timeouts (options helvetia.connectTimeout, helvetia.timeout) and retry on connection errors.

helvetia 0.1.0

First version.

  • Registers: gemeinde(), gemeindeMutationen(), raumgliederung() (experimental), praemienregion(), kanton().
  • Statistics: popGemeinde(), arealGemeinde(), noas().
  • Geometries: geoGemeinde(), geoBezirk(), geoKanton(), geoThemakart(), geoGewaesser(), themakartSets().
  • Maps and spatial tools: plotMap(), addGewaesser(), stampBfs(), combineRegions(), neighbours(), locate(), geocode().
  • Sources: sourceInfo(), cacheList(), cacheClear().

Names and signatures follow the suite’s design rules (v0.7.1): lowerCamelCase functions and arguments, kebab-case enum values, one @family and two to four @concept tags per topic.

Integration of bfsMaps

helvetia supersedes bfsMaps (1.99.4). The ThemaKart sets are found in the BFS data catalogue and downloaded into the cache automatically; DownloadBfSMaps(), maps.csv and the option bfsMaps.base are no longer needed. An existing unpacked set can still be used with options(helvetia.themakartDir = <path>, helvetia.themakartSet = <year>).

bfsMaps helvetia
GetMap("polg.map"), GetMap("kant.map"), … geoThemakart("gemeinde"), geoGemeinde(), geoKanton(), geoBezirk()
GetMap("kantvf.map"), GetMap("kant.pnt") geoThemakart("kanton", area = "vegetation"), geoThemakart("kanton", output = "point")
PlotKant(), PlotBezk(), PlotPolg(), PlotGreg(), PlotMSRe(), PlotCH() plotMap("kanton", ...), plotMap("grossregion", ...), plotMap("schweiz")
col.vf, border.vf plotMap(vegetation = list(col = , border = ))
tmtxt plotMap(stamp = )
AddLakes(), AddRivers(), AddWaters() addGewaesser(lakes = , rivers = ); data via geoGewaesser()
BfSStamp() stampBfs()
CombinePolygons(), CombineKant(), CombinePolg() combineRegions(map, groups, id)
PlotPremReg() plotMap(combineRegions(geoGemeinde(date), preg$preg_x, preg$gem_id)) with preg <- praemienregion(year)
Neighbours() neighbours() (data.frame of pairs)
SwissLocator() locate() (also for given coordinates)
GeoCode() geocode()
d.bfsrg gemeinde() + raumgliederung() for any stand; premium regions via praemienregion()
kt kanton()
tkart (session cache) local cache, see cacheList()
PlotMapDot() dropped: a plain layout() call
DownloadBfSMaps() dropped: automatic download

Behavioural changes compared to bfsMaps:

  • Premium regions are read from the BAG files on priminfo.admin.ch for any year from 2004, instead of a fixed snapshot of 2023.
  • stampBfs() honours cex and adj and uses the "bottomright" position (both were ignored in BfSStamp()); the default year is the set of the last map read instead of the current year.
  • The stand of a layer is chosen by date instead of a fixed file.
  • neighbours() returns all neighbours except the unit itself; Neighbours() additionally dropped all members of id.
  • No dependency on DescTools and httr any more.
